root_idea.summary: The root is centered on the number three and the organization of things into three, with extensions to thirds, ordinals, distributive groups, and threefold composition.
root_idea.development: The lexical development runs from counting three and identifying a third member or portion to dividing, repeating, grouping, or composing things in threes. Related formations also designate thirty, Tuesday, and objects characterized by three parts or strands.

senses.usage_conditions: The masculine form of the cardinal numeral, used in counting persons, things, periods, and other counted units; its case varies according to syntax.
The feminine form of the cardinal numeral, used with counted expressions and in such constructions as three times or three periods.
Occurs in the tens numeral ثَلَاثُونَ or its inflected form ثَلَاثِينَ; the Quranic group includes both cardinal-three and thirty forms.

senses.definition: Three and three; in groups or sets of three.
senses.usage_conditions: A distributive numeral, conventionally used with coordinated or successive groups to mean three at a time or three together.

senses.definition: A third; one of three equal parts or portions.
senses.usage_conditions: The singular denotes one third. Its dual forms ثُلُثَانِ and ثُلُثَيِ denote two thirds, with the expected case inflection.

senses.definition: Third; the third in sequence or the third member of a set.
senses.usage_conditions: The feminine form is ثَالِثَة. With a following genitive expression it can identify one member as the third of a group; in other constructions it can describe what makes a group three.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take a third share of a people's property; to remove a third portion from property. It can also be used of killing a third of a group.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form I transitive use, with the object being property or a group whose third is taken or removed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become the third of a group, or to make a group three by joining it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form I numerical construction; the subject may become third, or may make two others three with itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To increase a number by one so that it reaches thirty, or another analogous numerical total.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized numerical use extended through the series of number verbs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To turn over or cultivate the ground three times.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of land prepared by three successive turnings.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To come third in a race.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a horse or person finishing third.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the idiom لَا يَثْنِي وَلَا يَثْلِثُ, to be unable to rise for a third attempt.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic expression describing an old man who cannot rise repeatedly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make something three, divide it into three parts, or designate it as three.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II causative or factitive usage; the division may be into thirds, and the same formation supplies the verbal noun تَثْلِيث.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To assert or adopt the doctrine of the Trinity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A theological use of the Form II verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To count three items in a succession, especially to recognize a third successor after two.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic political or historical use, often contrasted with refusing to count a fourth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remain three nights, or to perform a saying or action three times.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may be used with a person, a period of residence, or repeated speech and action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To tie or bind three teats of a she-camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized pastoral construction referring to fastening the teats with a cord or similar binding.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of dates or grapes, to reach a stage in which a third has ripened.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used when approximately one third has become ripe or entered the relevant ripening state.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Watering seed-produce on the third day, or watering it again after one intervening day.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized agricultural interval expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a thing triangular or trilateral.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of giving an object three sides or angles.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a letter three-pointed or give it three diacritical dots.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical orthographic use, especially in distinguishing ثاء from similarly shaped letters.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A particular electuary or confection of aromatics or perfumes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional name for the preparation, not merely a general description of something threefold.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a party to become three, or to become thirty in the analogous numerical pattern.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form IV intransitive numerical usage, describing the resulting number of a group.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a female animal, to bear her third young one.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used especially of a camel or other female animal and the order of its offspring.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a grape-vine, to have one third of its fruit remaining after two thirds have been eaten.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized resultative use describing the remaining proportion of fruit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The third young one or offspring of a she-camel or other female animal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal designation of birth order; the source notes that the expression is not formed simply by calling the she-camel ثِلْث.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A three-day watering interval for palm-trees.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized agricultural term for watering once every three days or after omitting one day.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A tertian fever that attacks on one day, remits on the next, and returns on the third.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A medical expression based on the three-day recurrence pattern.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A vessel whose contents reach one third of its capacity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a vessel containing grain, drink, wine, or a similar measured substance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A tree known as عِنَبُ الثَّعْلَبِ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexicalized plant name with no necessary numerical meaning in ordinary use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel's girth, or related abdominal structure, described by the expression ذُو ثُلَاث.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized and partly variant expression applied to the girth, belly, or associated membranes of a lean female camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A garment made from the wool of three sheep.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional garment description using ثُلَاث in a non-numerical lexicalized expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel that fills three milking vessels at one milking.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A pastoral descriptor for the maximum stated quantity yielded at one milking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel with three functioning teats, or with one teat dried up, cut off, or otherwise rendered unusable.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sources record several closely related applications concerning the number or condition of the teats.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Thirteen.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A compound cardinal numeral with dialectal variation in the pronunciation of the second component.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Tuesday, the third day of the week.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form is conventionally altered from the ordinary ordinal or numeral to distinguish the weekday name.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Relating to three things; threefold.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A relational adjective derived from the numeral.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Three cubits in length or height.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a garment, piece of cloth, or boy.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A word composed of three letters, whether only the radicals or the radicals with augmentative material.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical grammatical and lexicological designation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The thirtieth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An ordinal use of the tens numeral ثَلَاثُونَ in addition to its cardinal meaning thirty.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who fasts alone on Tuesday.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A relational noun formed from the weekday name.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The projecting third support of a cooking tripod, a projecting part of a mountain to which two stones are joined.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed expression referring to the third support among the three stones supporting a cooking-pot.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Thirteenth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A compound ordinal construction, with masculine and feminine forms and dialectal variation in declension.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The Trinity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexicalized theological noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A lute chord composed of three twists; according to another explanation, the third chord.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical musical term with recorded variation in whether the reference is to the number of twists or ordinal position.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel or other female animal bringing forth her third young one.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A participial noun describing the animal by the order of its offspring.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A triangular or trilateral thing; a triangle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a thing having three angles or corners, including a three-sided piece of land.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing composed of three layers, folds, strata, or distinct fascicles.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The formation can describe things composed of three parts and, by analogy, similar formations with other numbers.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In lexicology, a word or verb whose relevant letter may bear any of the three vowels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical grammatical designation for forms written or pronounced with three possible vowelings.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Three-pointed or marked with three diacritical points.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical orthographic adjective, especially in reference to a letter such as ثاء.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wine or grape juice cooked until two thirds have evaporated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional culinary or beverage term defined by the amount removed through cooking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A particular electuary or aromatic confection.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexicalized name for the preparation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A calumniator who slanders one person to another in a way said to destroy three people: himself, his fellow, and the ruler.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative conventional noun based on the three persons affected by the slander.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Property or another thing from which a third part has been taken.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The passive participle can also be applied to a verse or poetic measure from which a third has been removed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In prosody, a verse or metre from which two of six feet have been removed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized metrical use; terminology distinguishes it from a form in which two thirds have been removed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A rope composed of three strands twisted or woven together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The same naming pattern may extend to ropes of several other numbers of strands.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A garment woven from wool, camel hair, and goat hair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional textile designation based on its three materials.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A leathern water-bag made from three skins.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional description of the bag's construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land turned over three times for sowing or cultivation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive participial description of repeatedly prepared ground.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Making a thing a third part is covered by the broader Form II division meaning.
The ordinary third-part meaning is directly covered by the Quranic fractional sense.
Pointer-only cross-reference to the cardinal numeral.
The distributive meaning is represented by the Quran-attested distributive numeral.
The cardinal-number meaning is represented by the Quranic cardinal sense.
The unit supports both the Quran-attested cardinal thirty and the broader ordinal use.
The ordinary ordinal meaning is represented by the Quranic ordinal sense.
Analogy and cross-reference without an independent definition.

cautions: The QAC grouping for ثَلَاث combines ordinary cardinal-three occurrences with the tens form ثَلَاثُونَ/ثَلَاثِينَ; these are separated as distinct senses.
The Quranic forms ثُلُث, ثَالِث, and ثُلَاث represent distinct fractional, ordinal, and distributive uses rather than interchangeable translations.
